manualPrerequisites: Developer Mode enabled on the TV by the owner, with the owner's PC as the trusted host.
A root-capable privileged transport for this exact firmware. Not included in this toolkit; the owner supplies it.
The owner's own Samsung/Tizen signing certificate for installing the launcher package. Never shipped here.
The XattrBackup helper built from tools/xattr-backup and a .NET 6 runtime on the TV for xattr dump and restore.
A remote control within reach and the owner present for every verify-control step.
